evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

notes_for_editor: Single source: a Wikipedia list whose status for this tower carries a question mark, with no build, staffing, access or removal date. The name may be a spelling variant of Antioch (a Claiborne Parish community shows up in search results), but no source says so. Anyplace America and AboutUs search hits are auto-generated topo pages and were not used. The GNIS ID the list gives (1630038) does not appear in the cached USGS domestic-names file for Louisiana or any state, so it could not be checked there. No photos found. The record's coordinates are not checked against any second source.
